idea-plugin.name: AI File Opener
idea-plugin.description:
Automatically opens files in the editor as an AI coding agent works on them.

When an external AI tool (Claude Code, Aider, or any other agent) edits or creates a source file on disk, this plugin detects the change via IntelliJ's Virtual File System and opens the file in the editor — so you can follow along in real time without manually navigating to each file.

No setup required beyond installing the plugin. Works standalone — no companion plugin or IDE integration needed.

Compatible with all JetBrains IDEs (IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, etc.). Only source files within the open project are opened; build artifacts, vendor directories, and .git folders are ignored.
